harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Installed podman on node1, created unprivileged user appsvc with subuid/subgid ranges, enabled systemd linger for appsvc, and deployed a rootless podman container (nginx:alpine) as a user-level systemd unit (webapp.service, WantedBy=default.target) publishing port 8080. Verified the app serves HTTP 200 on $NODE_IP:8080 while appsvc has zero active login sessions. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured baseline boot_id and service state, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, confirmed boot_id changed post-reboot, and verified webapp.service came back active/enabled and serving HTTP 200 on port 8080 with still no login session for appsvc.
actions_performed: Installed podman, uidmap, slirp4netns via apt on node1
Created unprivileged user appsvc (nologin shell) with auto-assigned subuid/subgid ranges
Enabled systemd linger for appsvc (loginctl enable-linger)
Pulled docker.io/library/nginx:alpine as appsvc via rootless podman
Created ~appsvc/.config/systemd/user/webapp.service running the container with -p 8080:80, enabled with WantedBy=default.target
Verified service active, port 8080 listening, and HTTP 200 response with no login sessions present
Captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1 via systemctl reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed new boot_id
Re-verified webapp.service active/enabled, port 8080 serving HTTP 200, and no login sessions after reboot

evidence.requirement: appsvc unprivileged user created with no prior existence, linger enabled to permit boot-time systemd --user without an active login session
evidence.summary: Confirmed appsvc did not exist beforehand, created it with subuid/subgid ranges, enabled linger (Linger=yes), and showed appsvc's systemd --user instance running via linger

evidence.requirement: Containerized web app running as appsvc, serving on port 8080, no active login session
evidence.summary: Installed podman, pulled nginx:alpine as appsvc, created and enabled webapp.service (rootless podman container on port 8080), verified port listening and HTTP 200, and confirmed zero login sessions (loginctl list-sessions: 'No sessions') while service ran

evidence.requirement: Starts at boot (survives restart) while account has no active session
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id (901ef286...) and active service/HTTP 200; issued systemctl reboot which returned before disconnect; polled node1 and observed new boot_id (18574b17...) confirming genuine restart; verified webapp.service came back active/enabled, port 8080 serving HTTP 200, fresh podman/nginx process tree under appsvc, and no login sessions post-reboot
